text:
Aisha Kaur: Morning team — quick roundtable to kick off Greymatter onboarding. Goal: align stakeholders, surface any renewal risks, and agree on 30/60/90 success criteria. Who should be on the invite?

Tom Rivera: Count me in. 30m ok. I can cover dedicated config notes and SLA expectations.

Priya Shah: 10:30 PT works for me. I’ll lead the integrations + sample prompts portion. Need Greymatter to share an example corpus and API key.

Liam O'Connor: I’ll own the timelines/enablement plan. Proposed agenda: intros (5m), success criteria (10m), milestones & owners (10m), next steps/doc links (5m).

Aisha Kaur: Agenda sounds good. FYI priority risk: their legal/compliance timeline is tight — if onboarding slips past ~45 days renewal could be at risk. Suggest we surface that up front.

Tom Rivera: Noted. @Priya can you flag infra items that might block private deployment? Also please add `redwood:onboard` label to the ticket queue.

Priya Shah: Will do. Quick checklist I’ll share before the call: 1) Org onboarding form 2) API keys & sample corpus 3) Test dataset size 4) SSO/SCIM details 5) Compliance docs (SOC2, DPIA). Doc link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/greymatter (internal).

Liam O'Connor: I’ll add tentative milestone dates in that doc and assign owners. Can someone run the first enablement demo? @Tom any preference?

Tom Rivera: I can run the demo. Prefer Wed morning so we don’t lose momentum.

Aisha Kaur: I’ll invite Greymatter PM (Jules) + Security lead (Maya) for Wed 11:00 PT. Please confirm availability by EOD. We also need a feedback capture owner to send a 1-week post-demo survey.

Priya Shah: I’ll own feedback capture and the initial eval prompt set. I’ll prep a 5-question survey focused on latency, relevance, and integration pain points.

Liam O'Connor: Great. Action items summary: Aisha — send invites; Priya — checklist + survey + prompt set; Tom — demo prep; Liam — timeline & notes. I’ll take meeting notes and post them here.

OnboardBot: Meeting scheduled: Wed 11:00 PT — Greymatter Onboarding Roundtable. Invite sent to: Jules (Greymatter PM), Maya (Greymatter Sec), Aisha Kaur, Tom Rivera, Priya Shah, Liam O'Connor. Calendar link: https://cal.link/greymatter-roundtable

Aisha Kaur: One more item — I’ll create a Gainsight ticket and tag the account with 'renewal-risk:monitor' given their compliance calendar. If onboarding stretches, we should escalate to AM.

Tom Rivera: Please add me to the ticket. Infra pre-reqs I need: VPC endpoint details, GPU quota request accepted, and an estimate of test dataset size.

Priya Shah: I’ll ask Jules to confirm dataset size in the invite thread and attach a sample.

Aisha Kaur: Thanks all. Let’s keep updates here so the customer-facing threads stay concise. I’ll post the meeting notes and the owner-assigned checklist after the call.

Tom Rivera: 👍

Priya Shah: Seen — prepping materials.

Liam O'Connor: Will update the timeline doc after the call.
